parsed.why: Documented 2025 border mocking of a trans traveller by immigration officials, state censorship of LGBT expression, no anti-discrimination, hate-crime or recognition machinery, conversion practices routine — hostile state climate with no recourse, but no detention or violence pattern.

No criminalisation now, but no recognition procedure, no discrimination protection, police harassment of LGBTQ venues and Pride, organised religious opposition, and 69% backing criminalisation — hostile society with thin recourse, though no documented trans-visitor incident.

Public same-sex affection criminalised with heavy penalties, documented arrests via false accusations, law-enforcement mistreatment and torture of LGBTQ people, no recognition, no organisations, entrenched stigma — state-linked hostility with effectively no recourse.

Hate-speech and anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, hate-crime framework, self-declaration recognition, marriage equality, liberal society; but rising hate crimes, 8% reporting, falling clearance and a Pride mass shooting temper an otherwise protective regime.

Gender-identity discrimination remedy with damages awarded, 2025 national hate-crime law, marriage equality, lived-gender custody standards; patchwork state coverage and organised exclusion campaigns are the main friction, offset by working national protections.
